feature: Original complete-disclosed-equity cent weights applied to each stock's strictly positive original net_mf_amount over every prior-month exchange session; denominator retains all stocks and sessions.
missingness: Exact integer/rational bounds from separate method review. Identified state 1 if L>1/2, 0 if H<=1/2, otherwise unknown. No imputation, renormalization, removal or midpoint proxy.
source_exception: Conditional retrospective latest-vintage mapped moneyflow and retained report/action sources. Original complete-cell and historical-vintage guards remain failed; this explicit limited diagnostic cannot certify contemporaneous availability, complete revisions or tradability.
calendar_rule: Keep all 38 frozen intervals. Any unexpected source identity, snapshot, revision-title, calendar, duplicate-key or price defect invalidates this attempt; no outcome-dependent exclusion.

price_basis.name: one_share_open_to_open_declared_cash_gross_v1
price_basis.formula: (exit raw open + cash distributions whose record_date is on/after entry and before exit - entry raw open) / entry raw open
price_basis.cash_entitlement: Hold one theoretical ETF unit from entry open through the session before exit open. Use disclosed record dates, not announcement or payment dates; validate record_date is the preceding session of ex_date for all included events.

statistics.primary: D=mean(z*(y-mean(y))); D>0 is equivalent to selected mean exceeding unconditional mean when selected count is nonzero. For unknown z, compute sharp extrema by choosing each coefficient's adverse/favorable binary endpoint. Do not claim unknown states are executable signals.
statistics.absolute: Sharp selected-return-mean bounds across all possible unknown-state completions, using sorted-return prefix sums for each possible selected count. Empty selection is undefined and fails qualification. Also report selected-count and win-rate bounds.
statistics.bootstrap: 5000 paired circular moving-block resamples of whole (state,y) months, block length 3, seed 20260921. Recompute centered D bounds in every resample; report 5th/95th percentiles. This is descriptive after prior searches, not fresh OOS inference.
statistics.qualification: At least 6 identified-positive months overall and 3 in the fixed later slice; at least one identified-zero overall; full-sample 5th percentile of D lower bound >0; full and later selected-mean lower bounds >0; later D lower bound >0.

next_if_qualified: Separate frozen 10000-CNY account test with 1000-CNY position cap and minimum commission 0/5/10 plus slippage scenarios; this registration grants no account execution.
next_if_not_qualified: Close this fixed hypothesis without sign flip, cutoff search, new windows or parameter rescue.
reviewer: Project lead autonomous self-review before any actual flow signs or ETF outcomes for this hypothesis; no independent review claimed.
